source_facts_to_preserve: The hypothetical instantaneous-signal synchronization example is counterfactual, not an available physical operation.
Separated events are judged against clocks synchronized within the selected reference frame.
Finite signal travel delay must be accounted for when using light or radio time signals.
Vacuum light speed is the same constant in each inertial frame.
A flash from the spacecraft midpoint reaches its two endpoints simultaneously in the spacecraft rest frame K_1.
Clocks A and B are fixed at opposite spacecraft endpoints; their source roles and figure references remain identifiable.
In frame K the spacecraft is moving, so the front endpoint moves away from the emission position and the rear endpoint moves toward it.
The two reception events occur at different K times; this does not make c plus or minus v the measured inertial-frame light speed.
The flash-reception events can be simultaneous in K_1 without being simultaneous in K.
A and B clock-setting differences between frames are not an intrinsic malfunction or unequal clock rates.
The two inertial frames obey the same physical laws; neither is privileged.
Space-separated simultaneity is frame-dependent under the relativity principle and invariant vacuum light speed, not finite propagation alone.
The displaced-wavefront paradox from n94 assumed a common time slice across frames; different frames select different simultaneous events on the expanding light wave.
The reversed comparison is symmetric when the frame roles are interchanged.
All approved source references and figure ownership remain covered; zero source questions means no fabricated exercise or choice objects.
adaptation_judgment: Child-readable explanation may replace polemical wording, but must retain physical conditions and distinguish hypotheses from observations.
The 0:45 time is a conceptual counterfactual synchronization example, not an unseen numerical exercise.
Language and paragraph layout may be modernized without changing the frame relationships.
No new mathematical erratum or correction is introduced into the faithful source layer.
Review must distinguish textual scientific approval from pending modern-figure and native display approval.
